## Overview

This section maps individual skill gaps identified in the Skill Gap Analysis to concrete career development actions for each team member. Proficiency ratings are self-assessed on a 1–5 scale and benchmarked against Lightcast 2024 IT job posting demand.

## Shared Priority: Machine Learning

Every team member rated Machine Learning at 2 or below — the single most consistent gap across the group. Given that ML ranks among the most demanded skills in Lightcast IT job postings, this is the team's top collective development priority.

**Recommended resources:**
- Coursera Machine Learning Specialization (Andrew Ng)
- fast.ai — Practical Deep Learning
- Databricks Academy — Apache Spark ML
